career_progression.long_term_stage: Stage 5: Enterprise Talent / Strategic HR Leadership
career_goals: Master Strategic Talent Development and Talent Management leadership
Build end-to-end succession planning and critical-role risk frameworks
Champion People Analytics, predictive talent modeling, and L&D ROI
Pioneer AI-powered learning and digital workforce capability (AI Academy)
Advance toward Head / Director of Talent Management & Strategic HR

weekly_plan.why_matters: Leveraging SIMBA Spark and bite-sized learning to drive enterprise adoption and daily engagement.

core_ld.title: Harvard Business Review Guide: How to Evaluate Training and Prove L&D ROI
core_ld.career_stage: Stage 5: Enterprise Talent / Strategic HR Leadership
core_ld.summary: Executive methods for measuring training impact, calculating financial return on learning investments, and reporting to board members.
core_ld.why_relevant: Directly supports executive presentations and L&D business-case justifications at TD Africa.
core_ld.td_africa_application: Apply the frameworks from 'Harvard Business Review Guide: How to Evaluate Training and Prove L&D ROI' directly to refine TD Africa's annual TNA cycle, integrate modular lessons into SIMBA Spark microlearning, and deliver measurable capability metrics for executive reporting.

core_tm.title: Succession Management in Practice: Moving Beyond the Static 9-Box
core_tm.summary: Empirical research on building agile talent pools, accelerating high-potential readiness, and running impactful talent review boards.
core_tm.why_relevant: Directly guides the design and implementation of succession slates at TD Africa.
core_tm.practical_application: Use this resource to pilot a structured 9-Box talent assessment and succession slate across one critical department at TD Africa.

core_broader.title: Strategic Workforce Planning & Capability Forecasting Factsheet
core_broader.provider: CIPD (Chartered Institute of Personnel and Development)
core_broader.summary: Step-by-step guidance on identifying future skill requirements, assessing workforce gaps, and linking talent development to commercial business plans.
core_broader.why_relevant: Equips the user with executive frameworks to forecast organizational capabilities for TD Africa.

challenge.title: Build an Automated Power BI / Excel L&D Executive KPI Dashboard
challenge.instructions: Connect LMS completion and evaluation data to visualize: 1) Monthly Completion Rate, 2) Kirkpatrick Level 2 Skill Gain, 3) Cost per Learning Hour.

portfolio_evidence.description: An executive-ready dashboard communicating learning effectiveness, adoption velocity, and training ROI.

three_actions.learn: Complete 'Harvard Business Review Guide: How to Evaluate Training and Prove L&D ROI' and 'Succession Management in Practice: Moving Beyond the Static 9-Box' (30-45 mins + 30-45 mins).
three_actions.apply: Build an Automated Power BI / Excel L&D Executive KPI Dashboard (50 mins).
three_actions.capture: Save 'L&D Executive Analytics Dashboard' to your professional career portfolio.

reflection_questions: What critical insight from this week's resources challenges our current approach at TD Africa?
How can the practical challenge deliverable be integrated into upcoming talent review or training cycles?
What behavioral shift in leadership or capability development did this study reveal?
weekly_plan.next_action: Complete the 'Build an Automated Power BI / Excel L&D Executive KPI Dashboard' and archive the evidence in your portfolio before next Monday.
